narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed stable operating margins at 24%, but this is lower than the 25.3% reported in Mar 2026.
Annual revenue grew to 267,021.0 crore in Mar 2026, supporting the claim of better international market performance.
Operating cash flow reached 52,094.0 crore in Mar 2026, consistent with strong 105% OCF to PAT conversion.
